programme.title: Informatik studieren (Bachelor) ✔ TU Dresden
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science, 6 semesters, PO 2025; open admission (zulassungsfrei), winter semester start
programme.how_found: tu-dresden.de/ing/informatik -> Studies -> Degree Programmes (/ing/informatik/studium/studienangebot) -> 'Computer Science, Bachelor of Science (PO 2025)' -> SINS link (sins_studiengang?autoid=281). The SINS list itself (sins_start) is JavaScript-only.
programme.notes: The plain URL is served in English to Accept-Language en (the production fetcher's header); the page's own 'Deutsch' link adds &set_language=de. Faculty page: https://tu-dresden.de/ing/informatik/studium/studienangebot/bachelor-studiengaenge/informatik-po-2025/index. The faculty lists the bachelor under 'Undergraduate degree programs - German-language'; there is no English-taught CS bachelor (English programmes are Master's only).

english.quote: with an overall score of at least TestDaF 4 in the sections
english.notes: German-taught; immediate start needs DSH 2, TestDaF 4 in all sections, DSD II, telc C1 Hochschule or equivalent. Not an English requirement.

gpa.notes: Open admission (no NC): no grade threshold; a foreign qualification without direct access requires the Studienkolleg (T-course).

deadline.quote: Application period for non-EU applicants 1st April – 15th July
deadline.notes: International round: non-EU applicants, first semester, winter semester start. The date is printed without a year ('1st April – 15th July'); page says 'Information valid until May 2027'.

tuition.notes: SINS row: 'Tuition fees per semester semester fee and, if applicable, second degree and long-term tuition fees' — no general tuition for non-EU students, only the semester contribution (amount not quoted) plus fees for second degree (EUR 350/semester) or long-term study (500 EUR/Semester), https://tu-dresden.de/studium/im-studium/studienorganisation/semesterbeitrag-studiengebuehren. No single published amount for this applicant.

scholarship_exists.quote: The Deutschlandstipendium provides students with 300 euros per month
scholarship_exists.notes: Deutschlandstipendium at TU Dresden: 300 EUR/month for a year (extendable); merit-based, competitive; applications open yearly 1-15 July for enrolled students (or applicants who have applied for a place).

scholarship_international.quote: Deutschlandstipendium (12 months merit scholarship, irrespective of income; applications open yearly 01st to 15th July)
scholarship_international.notes: Listed on TU Dresden's page 'Scholarships for applicants and students from abroad'; that listing is the only evidence (no explicit nationality sentence was found).
